criteria.description: No SKILL.md block runs git diff HEAD~1 HEAD
criteria.note: Step 3a now calls finalise-diff.sh. grep finds 'HEAD~1' only in prose at SKILL.md:547, which describes the old fallback, not in a block. The test asserts doesNotMatch /git diff HEAD~1 HEAD/ over the whole SKILL.md. It runs in test.yml npm test.

criteria.description: Step 3a writes a **PR diff:** line for merge-base, forge, unresolved
criteria.note: printf '**PR diff:** %s\\n' \"$DIFF_LINE\". The test pulls the Step 3a block out of SKILL.md and runs it in bash and zsh for all three sources. Per-PR via test.yml.

criteria.description: AC prompt fails a set criterion on an empty names list
criteria.note: The quantifier rule lists the members from <DIFF_FILE>.names. An empty or missing list fails the criterion with 'the change could not be read'. The contract test pins both sentences and runs per PR via test.yml.

criteria.description: Docs/fix-evidence prompts FAIL empty diff; check 5 reads .names
criteria.note: Both prompts say an empty or missing names list is `FAIL` with \"the change could not be read\", never PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE. Fix-evidence check 5 reads the copies from `<DIFF_FILE>.names`, not `<DIFF_FILE>`. Test :1407 pins the sentence in every diff-reading prompt and refuses NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW. Test :1446 pins check 5. Both run per PR.

criteria.description: bundle:check passes; shellcheck passes on the new script
criteria.note: Re-run read-only at head 19c106141: `npm run bundle:check` printed '129 skill(s) checked, 0 problems' (rc 0). `bash scripts/lint-shell.sh` printed 'shellcheck: clean' (rc 0; it runs --severity=warning over the sources, finalise-diff.sh included). validate.yml (path-filtered to skills/** and shared/resources/**, both touched) and shellcheck.yml run per PR. Bare `shellcheck` without a severity reports one info-level SC1091 on the `. \"$HERE/pr-read.sh\"` source line; the project lane does not count info.
Re-run read-only at head: `npm run validate -- skills/finalise/` printed '✓ finalise'. validate.yml runs quick_validate.py per skill on this PR (it touches skills/**).

CHANGELOG.md:126 is under `## [Unreleased]` (line 5; the next header is v0.69.0 at line 166). It reads '`/finalise` judges the PR's whole change, or says it could not read it (task 321)' and goes on to describe finalise-diff.sh, the names list, `unresolved` and `<DIFF_LINE>`, which names the change. The repo has no corpus guard that pins this entry.
